description: What each artifact type's document accepts and refuses (Transporter Artifact specification; field limits on the Limits page). `type` is the artifact type the document travels in. Apply `fill` (a string of `length` characters at `path`, `prefix` and `suffix` included, the rest the letter "a") and `repeat` (`times` copies of `item` at `path`) to `document` first. An implementation accepts every "accept" case and refuses every "refuse" case; `why` says what is wrong.
